newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kmart upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kmart upgraded to buy.

text.p: Smith Barney said on Monday it raised its rating on the shares of Kmart Corp to buy from neutral, with a 12 to 18-month target of $17 per share.
-- Analyst Rick Church said he raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.70 per share from $0.60 per share and his 1998 earnings estimate to $1.05 per share from $0.85 per share.

-- "There is evidence in the second quarter that the strategies management put in place are gaining increasing credibility and results, and should improve the outlook for sales, margins and earnings," Church said.
